Name: Magical Creatures for Nature in the Valley
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[b]Magical Creatures[/b] adds 35 creatures to the valley— elemental spirits, enchanted animals, ancient oddities, and one thing that is definitely a treasure chest and absolutely nothing else. Some only appear in snowfall. Some come out during storms. Some only exist after dusk. Some glow in the dark.

Explore the forest at night. Walk the beach at high tide. Check the caves in winter. The valley has magic in every corner.

[heading]Creatures[/heading]
🌱 Spring
[b]Dawnpetal Butterfly[/b] — Common. Active 7am–6pm. Its petal-shaped wings carry a faint floral scent. Bees are frequently confused by it.
[b]Fernback Deer[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. A small magical deer with living ferns and wildflowers growing from its antlers.
[b]Moonhare[/b] — Common. Active all day. A pale silver hare with glowing markings that shift like moonlight on water. 
[b]Mossback Snail[/b] — Common. Active all day. Its shell has become a thriving miniature garden. It doesn't seem to mind at all.
[b]Seafoam Sprite[/b] — Rare. Active all day. Beach only. Born from sea foam and moonlight, they vanish back into the waves at dawn. 
[b]Thornhop Sprite[/b] — Common. Active 7am–7pm. A mischievous fae-like creature that leaps through the underbrush on thorny little legs.
[b]Crystal Beetle[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. Its shell contains no crystals — it IS crystal. Nobody is quite sure how it is alive.
[b]Verdant Wisp[/b] — Rare. Active 7pm–2am. Drifts toward areas of new growth, drawn by something no one has named. 
[line]
☀️ Summer
[b]Duskpetal Fairy[/b] — Rare. Active 5pm–2am. A tiny creature made from dried petals and fading light. 
[b]Emberspark Salamander[/b] — Rare. Active 6pm–2am. A sleek salamander laced with glowing lava veins. 
[b]Emberveil Moth[/b] — Uncommon. Active 5pm–2am. Seen as if it draws warmth from the changing colors of the season.
[b]Faerie Cicada[/b] — Common. Active all day. Legend says that if you hear one at dusk, your wish will come true by morning. 
[b]Forest Spirit[/b] — Rare. Active 7pm–2am. A luminous spirit shaped like a deer of woven light. 
[b]Lunar Moth[/b] — Uncommon. Active 7pm–2am. Sunny weather only. Its wings absorb moonlight throughout the day and release their glow at dusk. 
[b]Moonhare[/b] — Common. Active all day. Its color is akin to the full moon on a hot summer night. 
[b]Mossback Snail[/b] — Common. Active all day. Does not flee. It moves so slowly that's it's grown moss on its shell. 
[b]Pearl Nautilus[/b] — Rare. Active all day. Beach only. An ancient creature whose iridescent shell has outlasted kingdoms. 
[b]Phantom Stag Beetle[/b] — Rare. Active all day. Cave only. A translucent beetle so ancient its shell has gone nearly see-through. 
[b]Shimmer Owl[/b] — Rare. Active 7pm–2am. An owl whose feathers shift colors depending on the angle of the light. 
[b]Starweaver Dragonfly[/b] — Very Rare. Active 8am–8pm. Its wing markings map different star formations each month.
[b]Thornhop Sprite[/b] — Common. Active 7am–7pm. A mischievous fae-like creature that leaps through the underbrush on thorny little legs.
[b]Tidecaller Crab[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. Beach only. Its seafoam shell shimmers at high tide. Fishermen consider them omens of calm water.
[line]
🍂 Fall
[b]Duskpetal Fairy[/b] — Rare. Active 5pm–2am. A tiny creature made from dried petals and fading light.
[b]Emberfox[/b] — Common. Active all day. A small fox whose tail burns with cold ember flame. 
[b]Emberveil Moth[/b] — Uncommon. Active 5pm–2am.  Seen as if it draws warmth from the changing colors of the season.
[b]Emberspark Salamander[/b] — Rare. Active 6pm–2am. It looks like it crawled out of your campfire. 
[b]Hollow Cricket[/b] — Common. Active 6pm–2am. Its body glows amber from within like a lantern. Its song carries further than it should.
[b]Lunar Moth[/b] — Uncommon. Active 7pm–2am. Sunny weather only. Wings like the harvest moon.
[b]Mimic[/b] — Very Rare. Active all day.  A predator that evolved to look exactly like a treasure chest. 
[b]Pearl Nautilus[/b] — Rare. Active all day. Beach only. A favored pet of mermaids. 
[b]Phantom Stag Beetle[/b] — Rare. Active all day. Cave only. It's carapace glimmers like the gems around it. 
[b]Rotbloom[/b] — Very Rare. Active 6pm–2am. A walking flower with pale flesh-veined petals and a ring of teeth where the pollen should be.
[b]Rootweave Spider[/b] — Uncommon. Active 6pm–2am. Weaves glowing webs between ancient trees. The threads pulse faintly, like a heartbeat.
[b]Shimmer Owl[/b] — Rare. Active 7pm–2am. WIngs like the northern lights. 
[b]Starling Squirrel[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. A deep blue-black squirrel dusted with white star-like speckles. 
[b]Tidecaller Crab[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. Beach only. Comes and goes with the tides. 
[b]The Watcher[/b] — Exquisite. Active 6pm–2am. A column of writhing tentacles topped by a single enormous lidless eye. Beware.
[b]Voidgazer[/b] — Very Rare. Active 6pm–2am. A drifting mass of eyeballs.The central pupil opens onto an absence of everything. 
[line]
❄️ Winter
[b]Aurora Moth[/b] — Very Rare. Active 7pm–2am. Sunny weather only. Wings display shifting bands of aurora light. 
[b]Cave Luminae[/b] — Exquisite. Active all day. Cave only. A small creature made entirely of bioluminescent crystal. 
[b]Crystal Beetle[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. It's shell shines like diamonds in the sunlight. 
[b]Emberfox[/b] — Common. Active all day.  A small fox whose tail burns with cold ember flame. 
[b]Frostchime Sprite[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. Snow weather only. A tiny fairy made of living ice crystals.
[b]Frostwing Moth[/b] — Uncommon. Active 7pm–2am. Its wings are etched with frost crystal patterns that shift like ice forming on glass. 
[b]Glacial Scarab[/b] — Uncommon. Active all day. A beetle that glistens like the magnificent glaciers. 
[b]Snowbell Sprite[/b] — Common. Active all day. A tiny winter faerie.
[line]
🌦️ Storm weather only
[b]Stormcaller Moth[/b] — Very Rare. Active all day. Spring, Summer, and Fall, but only during storms. Its wings crackle with contained lightning. Floats.
[line]
🌑 Year-round, evening only
[b]Star Coyote[/b] — Rare. Active 6pm–2am. Spring through Fall. A lean coyote whose midnight blue fur is mapped with constellation patterns that slowly shift as it moves.

[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Install Nature in the Valley[/*]
[*]Drop into your mods folder[/*]
[/list]No configuration needed. All creatures integrate automatically with the NITV insectarium, encyclopedia, and museum display.
[line]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+. No known conflicts with other NITV content packs or mods.
